scenes.head:
Print quality starts
at the squeegee
bullets: Often a worn blade or poor holder
vo: Insufficient paste, bridging and paste spilling over the blade ends often start at the squeegee.
Short paste, bridging and spill often start at the squeegee.
Southern Machinery supplies squeegees for the printers already on your line.

scenes.head:
DEK, MPM, GKG,
Panasonic, Yamaha …
vo: Holders are made for D E K, M P M, G K G, Desen, Zhengshi, Panasonic, Yamaha, EKRA and more.
Holders for DEK, MPM, GKG, Desen, Zhengshi, Panasonic, Yamaha, EKRA and more.
Original part numbers are kept, so you order by printer model, for example D E K S Q A three hundred.
Original part numbers kept - e.g. DEK SQA300.

scenes.head: 150 to 750 mm
vo: Lengths from one hundred fifty to seven hundred fifty millimetres, stainless blades point three millimetres as standard, from point two to point five on request.
150 to 750 mm. Stainless 0.3 mm standard, 0.2 to 0.5 mm on request.
Rubber blades with bevel, flat or pointed edge for glue printing.
Rubber blades for glue printing.

scenes.head: Keep paste in the print area
vo: Choose fixed rubber, fixed stainless or elastic end dams.
Fixed rubber, fixed stainless or elastic end dams.
Elastic dams follow the stencil, so paste stays where it prints instead of drying at the blade ends.
Paste stays in the print area - no dried paste at the ends.

scenes.head:
Blade change
in under 1 minute
vo: Our quick-change squeegee holds the blade in a magnetic slot, with no screws.
Quick-change type: magnetic blade slot, no screws.
Changing and cleaning a blade takes under a minute, against more than five minutes with screw-fixed blades.
Under 1 minute vs. more than 5 for screw-fixed blades.

scenes.head:
Inspect, store,
reuse
vo: For larger lines, the S T one inspection machine checks blade angle, notches and edge in about twenty seconds.
ST1 checks angle, notches and edge in about 20 s.
Storage cabinets give every squeegee a fixed place.
Storage cabinets give every squeegee a fixed place.

scenes.head: Tell us 4 things
vo: To order, send us your printer model, the part number or length, the blade type and the end dams you need.
Send printer model, part number or length, blade and end dams.
Southern Machinery printer squeegees, for every printer on your line.
